item.title: URAIHA Sign with Wanikiya Record, New Album in Progress
item.description: Wanikiya Record/Promotion is pleased to announce the official addition of the rock band Uraiha to its roster. Since 2018, the project has been leaving a significant mark on the Italian alternative music scene. item.title: DOOMCRUSHER Release New Single ‘Odyssey’
item.description: German metalcore force Doomcrusher continue their rapid ascent with the release of their brand-new single ‘Odyssey.’ Forged in an atmosphere shaped by uncertainty and upheaval, the project was created with a clear purpose: to push against stagnation and channel heaviness into something powerful, focused, and forward-moving.
